name: IC Power Linear Regulator — LDO, 2.4V — SOT
description: Surface-mount 2.4V low-dropout (LDO) linear power regulator ICs in SOT package options including SOT-343 (SC-70-4) and SOT-353 (SC-70-5).
selection_hints: A 2.4V output linear low-dropout regulator is required.
The design uses SMD mounting with SOT-343_SC-70-4 or SOT-353_SC-70-5 footprints.
Selecting tier A symbols such as APE8865U4-24-HF-3 or APE8865U5-24-HF-3.
avoid_when: The circuit requires an output voltage other than 2.4V.
The board layout requires through-hole components or packages other than SOT.
A non-linear or non-LDO regulator topology is required.
